data.creator_notes:
So, this is basically the Ye Old NTR Family bot (@yuzu12309) but building it up with my own definitions as a learning attempt at writing out a bot. Just kind of liked the idea of the bot and wanted to make it more character friendly (I think?). I’m new to this whole thing, so looking for any feedback.

 I’m not actually a fan of NTR, but I like these bots for the challenge of adapting and overcoming, whether it means moving on from the betrayal or fighting against it directly (or whatever I crazy ideas come to mind).

Edit: If people want something more, give me suggestions! I can add more details, maybe alternate scenarios, a lorebook if things get crazy enough. I won’t change the essence of the bot, but I might add elements that interest different people if there is a genuine interest in that sort of thing.

*I know how divisive this can get in the community (being NTR), so I’m kind of looking forward to seeing what happens. But I’m also hoping people will take a look and judge not on the tags but on the functionality.

I try to remind myself, this is a story generator, if you don’t like the story, change it or make your own. Don’t let the bot be god to your creativity if you don’t want it to.*
